profile: Coherus Oncology is a commercial-stage oncology company that commercializes LOQTORZI in the United States and develops cancer medicines. LOQTORZI is an approved PD-1 inhibitor for certain adults with nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Its clinical pipeline includes casdozokitug, an investigational IL-27 antagonist, and tagmokitug, an investigational CCR8-targeting antibody. The company holds global development and commercialization rights to both candidates.
